noncomputable def E2g (B : ℝ → ℝ) (κ T0 EB' EA' ρB ρA : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  EB' * (2 * Z3g B T0 / (1 - ρB) + 2 * c3g κ T0 / (1 - ρB) ^ 2) +
    EA' * (2 * Z3g B T0 / (1 - ρA) + 2 * c3g κ T0 / (1 - ρA) ^ 2)

note: Lean replaces the lemma with a zero-by-zero tail bound and Jensen-window zero counts, at H = 200. Erratum: The proof's step (9.66) rests on Lemma 9.1.3's decreasing-f clause, which drops f(T₀)g_χ(T₀); for ζ at H = 25, T₀ = 75, δ → 0 the zero sum Σ_{γ>75}f(γ) = 0.07975 exceeds (9.66)'s right side 0.06752, and with the term restored the method needs 94.28 (q = 1, H = 25, T₀ = 75), 70.28 (q = 3), 68.52 (q = 1, H = 200, T₀ = 250) and 27.5–27.8 at §9.6's heights instead of 11.308 (checked by `scripts/checks/lemma_9_4_1.py`).
